page.notes: The right-hand page is tilted and overlaps the left column, so the right ends of the left lines are cut off and marked [illegible]. The right page's lines are only partly readable, and the fragments above are my best reading of them. Some of the right page's lines could be show-through, which I could not separate with certainty. Paragraph breaks on the left are inferred from indents. Stray marks at the left edge and bottom left were treated as edge artefacts and not transcribed.
